node.title: Re^2: (Windows) verbatim command line arguments inside Perl script
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The quoting gets lost when the shell parses the command line arguments.

I'm not an expert, but I thought that part of the issue is that on Windows, that's actually not what happens? I'm looking at [id://847959].

Update: Unless with that sentence you were referring to *NIX systems, in which case you're right of course.
